goal.statement: Connect A2 to E2 by an unflooded walk while both rivers still water their rooted living groves at B3/D3.

Reach an exact repeating physical state whose entire cycle waters C2/C4 in nonoverlapping alternating phases, with both groves living/rooted and never flooded. The repeated state includes all fields, outlet selections, roots, records and source phases. World edits invalidate this cycle proof.
At completion (not an all-history invariant), make exact A-only/B-only originals at B1/D1; deliver combined A+B fragments but no exact identities at C2; retain an unflooded walk from A2 to E2.
